reason: Conversation 1 opens with 'switch it off and unplug it', which is unnecessary and counterproductive for a freezer that has already warmed up. Its final reply also ends with an irrelevant 'fridge not cooling' image tip. Conversation 2 uses the Bosch detail and the display to reach the right diagnosis (door ajar, temperature alarm, no fault). It gives clear steps (silence the alarm, close the drawer, let it recover), a sensible food-safety verdict for -9, and escalation only if the alarm recurs. It is weakened by US-style Fahrenheit units, an unnecessary unplug-reset suggestion, and a confident claim that the flashing number is the warmest temperature reached when the customer later says it is going down.
